claim_text: Massachusetts' Department of Transitional Assistance reported that SNAP enrollment in the state dropped by nearly 182,000 individuals, including roughly 65,000 children, and that daily call volume has risen 9% year on year with roughly 47% of callers unable to connect, up from 37%.
